mapper.select: SELECT * FROM arte_ai_tool_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE arte_ai_tool_task SET status = 'running', worker_id = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, next_attempt_at = NULL, attempt = attempt + 1, row_version = row_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND (status = 'queued' OR (status = 'running' AND lease_until <= #{now})) AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= #{now})

UPDATE arte_ai_tool_task SET lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, row_version = row_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'running' AND worker_id = #{workerId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM arte_ai_tool_task WHERE (status = 'queued' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= #{now})) OR (status = 'running' AND lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_attempt_at, create_time), id LIMIT #{limit}
